name: wispr-for-builders
description: Wispr for Builders, Pack 1: Claude Code mods for Wispr Flow. Say it, and your Mac does it.

plugins.name: wispr-guru
plugins.description: Talk back to Claude Code from the notch: when a thread finishes or needs a call, a card drops in and you answer with Wispr, a click or a number key. Guru also points at the control you need in any app and moves on when you click it.

plugins.name: wispr-review
plugins.description: Review any website by dictating at it. A Chrome extension pins each note to the element under your cursor; Claude reads the notes and fixes them.

plugins.name: wispr-pm
plugins.description: Task boards you dictate to: "park this for the portfolio", "split this into tasks", "what's waiting on me". Click Start on a card to run a Claude Code session on it. In progress.

plugins.name: wispr-video
plugins.description: A video editor you talk to: a teleprompter that follows you as you read, word-timed captions, and edits you describe. Exports 9:16, 4:5 and 16:9.

plugins.name: wispr-file
plugins.description: Find any file on your Mac by describing it. Pick from numbered thumbnails with a click or a number key; it pastes, reveals, opens or copies it. Spotlight runs locally.

plugins.name: wispr-wish
plugins.description: Say what you want done to a file: "make this a PDF", "compress this video for WhatsApp", "transcribe this". Plus tiny apps on request: timer, bill split, QR.

plugins.name: wispr-bridge
plugins.description: The harness the other mods share: routes a dictated request to the right mod and shows choices on a small numbered card you answer with a click or a number key, or by dictating anything longer.
